question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 4
solution:
The correct answer is '**can**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The context of the sentence requires a modal verb that indicates the ability or possibility.
 
• "Can" is the most appropriate option as it denotes the ability to buy goods and services.
 
• Other options ("ought", "must", and "should") imply obligation or necessity, which do not fit the context of indicating what money is able to purchase.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.
